title: equisetum limosum f. minus
intro: Equisetum limosum f. minus, commonly known as Marsh Horsetail, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Equisetaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the treatment of urinary issues, kidney stones, and gout due to its diuretic and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Equisetum limosum f. minus include its ability to act as a urinary tract antiseptic and an anti-inflammatory agent, reducing swelling and pain. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
